title: VPC Sentry: automated post-deploy verifier for API & model load smoke tests
creator: Daniel Park
description: Build an automated post-deploy verifier ("Sentry") that runs after every Private/VPC deployment and upgrade. The Sentry should validate API readiness, exercise the model warm-up and KV-cache loading flow with a lightweight synthetic workload, and run a short smoke suite that asserts latency, token correctness, and basic rate-limit behavior. This will be a Terraform-driven orchestration that triggers a set of ephemeral test runners in the target VPC, collects metrics, and posts results to the deployment dashboard. The goal is to catch regressions and misconfigurations introduced by IaC or runtime upgrades before routing customer traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Sentry executes automatically after Terraform apply in private deployments and emits a pass/fail result to the deployment console.
API readiness check returns 200 for health and /v1/models endpoints within configured SLA (95th percentile < 250ms) under synthetic load.
Model load test warms KV cache and verifies decode correctness on a canonical prompt set with BLEU/ROUGE-like sanity checks; failure thresholds configured.
Smoke tests include token-latency, streaming handshake, function-calling path, and an intentional rate-limit spike to confirm graceful 429 behavior.
Results, logs, and artifacts (model logs, kernel selection traces) are archived to the deployment run and linkable from the console.
Failure modes trigger an automatic hold in the rollout pipeline and create an incident ticket with prefilled logs and suggested next steps.
implementation_plan: Design terraform module 'sentry_verifier' that creates ephemeral test runners and necessary IAM roles in customer VPC.
Implement a lightweight runner image that contains: test harness, synthetic prompt set, and a small client for KV-cache priming.
Add orchestration hook in the private deploy pipeline to invoke the module post-apply and wait for result with timeout and retries.
Wire results into Console: create a /deployments/{id}/sentry endpoint and a short UI card with PASS/FAIL, key metrics, and links to logs.
Create rollout policy: on FAIL, block canary traffic, notify on-call, and optionally roll back to previous pinned model/version.
Add monitoring alerts for false-positive rate and test flakiness; plan a 2-week burn-in to tune thresholds.
test_plan: API readiness: curl health and /v1/models endpoints from an ephemeral runner located in the same subnet, assert JSON schema and latencies.
Model load: invoke canonical prompt set (10 prompts), ensure KV cache hit ratio increases and generation outputs match golden set similarity > 0.88.
Concurrency smoke: run 16 parallel streams for 30s to validate continuous batching behavior and no error spike above 0.5%.
Streaming and function-calls: open a streaming session and validate chunking + function-call metadata is present.
Rate-limit spike: send a short burst to confirm 429 responses are returned gracefully and downstream retries succeed after backoff.

2026-03-03 - Anjali Rao: prototype test runner image built (alpha); includes prompt set and basic KV priming script. CI image publish: ghcr.io/redwood/sentry-runner:alpha.

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Test runner may require elevated IAM privileges in customer VPC. Mitigation: limit scope to ephemeral minimal-role and document required permissions clearly.
Risk: False positives due to transient infra (e.g., noisy neighbor). Mitigation: run 3 attempts and require 2/3 failures to block rollout; surface full metrics to triage.
Risk: Additional deployment latency. Mitigation: make Sentry optional for small patches and configurable timeout; default enabled for full upgrades.
notes: Trade-off: Choosing a lightweight in-VPC runner increases realism but adds surface area to support; alternative was a synthetic agent in control plane which underestimates network paths.
Decision: Use similarity-based check rather than full evaluation to keep tests fast (avoid running long evals during rollout).
Follow-ups: Add a 'dry-run' mode that only validates IAM and artifact presence without exercising model to speed CI debugging.
qa_checklist: Run Sentry against staging and verify PASS/FAIL behavior across 5 consecutive deploys.
Validate that logs and kernel traces are uploaded and accessible from the console link.
Simulate failure modes (bad model binary, corrupted KV cache priming) and confirm pipeline blocks rollout.
Confirm IAM footprint is minimal and documented in README for the terraform module.
